complete_original_object.full_chain_observation:
One complete autonomous area-control policy, not an entity-versus-block variant: registered Horologium mantle reacts to qualified native player hurt, creates a fixed-center zone excluding current player numeric ID, commits shared mantle cooldown, then attempts400 charge drain. Gate includes actual chest mantle/weak registered constellation/enabled effect, server/nonfire/no cooldown/affordability. Original hurt is not canceled. No intervening shown charge mutation supports a free-zone claim; ignored drain result is only a transaction boundary. Defaults range20/life180/cooldown1000 are not installed configuration.
TimeStopController appends newly created zone into dimension list and separately requests provider ADD; return zone/non-null is not an accepted-target receipt. Zone lifetime decrements at SERVER START, then scans until expired; controller checks before and after tick, so last positive lifetime pass can capture and release within the same call. Producer removal or mantle swap does not revoke the autonomous zone.
TimeStopZone scans bounding chunks with world.getChunk, not a demonstrated loaded-only query. In-sphere tiles must be ITickable, permitted by blacklist and currently in world.tickableTileEntities. It removes the actual object before safeCacheTile. Cache deduplicates by BlockPos only. A same-position replacement can be removed without another cache record; overlapping zones observe the already-removed tick participant. No source-owned reference-counted lease.
On stop, retained object is reinserted only when current block reports a tile and constructing a fresh current-block tile yields a class assignable from the cached class. It reinserts the old cached object, not that new factory object or verified current tile. No current-instance identity, removal flag, generation, active overlapping owner or existing list-membership check. Cache is cleared and zone deactivated. Compatible replacement or overlapping lifetime issues are conditional static ownership boundaries, not reproduced duplication/permanent freeze.
Eligibility blacklist includes exact/subclass errored classes and configured type/prefix decisions. Defaults exclude storage and several Astral tiles. ConfigDataAdapter before build exposes empty generated data; postbuild class resolution/cached lists depend on external config lifecycle. Acceleration exception path can blacklist class for future scans; no retroactive release of already cached tiles is shown. No claim about actual installed target eligibility.
Concrete corrupted CEffectHorologium reuses center-containing zone without producer/range identity match and refreshes100, else creates a100 no-player zone. Full concrete class actually read, but parent ritual activation remains outside this new entry proof,0 extra producer credit. Normal acceleration uses bounded4..5 manual updates and exception blacklist; mode/constants/helpers0 extra.
Existing Main045 living/knockback update veto and selected maintenance are reused0. Area containment differs from direct freeze-ID membership, skips current excluded ID/dead/dying dragon/player-policy cases, uses current position geometry. LivingDestroyBlock direct-membership path does not become area tile-control evidence. This is native update participation control, not total motion stop, damage immunity or a Boss refusal implementation.
DataTimeFreezeEffects stores per-dimension helper list plus queued ADD/REMOVE; helper equality uses center/range but omits controller/owner/TTL/nonce. Equal geometry removal can remove a different helper. Per-world clear removes server display state without dirty/queued-clear operation, while server/client cleanup paths differ. No universal area-owner release acknowledgement.
Client helper read applies dimension area snapshots by clearing all, unlike prior direct entity-set reader absent-dimension behavior. Visual helper queries current nearby living/tile objects, not actual server tick cache. Controller identifier/geometry packet lacks accepted target identity, reason, expiry or release-result acknowledgement; particles and network transmission establish no authoritative freeze/restore.
World unload clears sync world state and asks controller to stop/release cached zones, then removes map; no explicit CLEAR display action. Client disconnect clears its local maps; server stop cleanup and world unload ordering remain native-engine boundaries. No source-owned durable zone/cache NBT: helper NBT is transport only, not a tested save/restore transaction.
Compared complete current saved SlowTime orphan cleanup, reversible statue actor host and replenished consumed Roots control-token decisions. Exact own prior Main045 Vortex whole judgment reused unchanged, not newly reread as another mechanism. Vortex renews a retained entity timeout/numeric membership; this policy removes tick-list objects, deduplicates positions and explicitly releases retained instances after a class-qualified current-block test. Combined capture/ownership/release differs; the shared entity veto/particles/registry/cooldown/config/resource/NBT helpers alone earn0.
Applicable to Dynasty final control admission and finite feedback ownership: authoritative refusal must be tied to the actual selected target and operation; area/source success is insufficient. Restore only the state this operation still owns, distinguish replacement and overlapping controllers, and use expiry/unload/client teardown receipts. This is one research reference only; no new gray text, Boss behavior, quest, art or production change.
